# Goutham Arelli

> Backend Engineer focused on scalable systems, reliability, and emerging agentic workflows.

This site is a portfolio for Goutham Arelli, a backend engineer based in Hyderabad, India. It is most relevant for backend engineering, platform engineering, distributed systems, payments/commerce backend, and AI-adjacent engineering roles.

## Site Sections

- Home: positioning, contact links, and resume download.
- Production Foundation: Pine Labs backend work around EMI systems, throughput, observability, reliability, and agentic commerce.
- AI/MCP Direction: early AI-agent infrastructure exploration grounded in backend systems knowledge.
- MCP Nexus: AI-assisted research prototype for an MCP gateway and connector marketplace.
- Experience Timeline: Pine Labs, Eduspeed Technologies, and Cognizant.
- Stack: backend, scale/reliability, AI/MCP exploration, databases, and frontend.

## Key Signals

- 4+ years backend/full-stack engineering experience.
- 2000+ TPS EMI Offer Discovery capacity improvement.
- 50% backend-call reduction through caching and lazy loading.

## MCP Nexus Caveat

MCP Nexus is an AI-assisted research prototype, not a production SaaS claim. It was built after deep exploration of MCP gateways, connector marketplaces, provider onboarding, tool permissions, governance, and secure agent-tool interaction patterns.

The work demonstrates architecture-led prototyping, research direction, workflow design, and AI-assisted implementation speed.
